issues.problem: bad[1].why was partly false: 不甘示弱的人 as a character trait is attested, so 'not a fixed trait' was an incorrect reason
issues.action: Rewrote why: the idiom is about rising to a rival's challenge and says nothing about stubbornness or being unhelpful

issues.problem: ctx[1] (customer breaks item and demands compensation) fits near-synonym 无理取闹 just as well
issues.action: Rewrote so the point is that no explanation gets through to him: 店员怎么解释他都不听，简直不可理喻

issues.problem: bad[1] (friends happily chatting all night) not clearly wrong to every native speaker; neutral descriptive uses of 喋喋不休 occur
issues.action: Replaced with a clear grammar misuse: 妈妈每天都喋喋不休我 (used transitively with the listener as object)

issues.problem: ctx[3] (accusation without proof, 还是在信口开河) fits near-synonym 胡说八道 equally well
issues.action: Rewrote as a dialogue about a repeated promise that won't be kept, which is what sets 信口开河 apart

issues.problem: ctx[3] (nobody knows the truth) fits near-synonym 议论纷纷 equally well; did not show the differing explanations
issues.action: Rewrote to list rival explanations: 有人说是跳槽，有人说是生病

issues.problem: Checked story against 《孟子·梁惠王下》 (邹与鲁哄, 有司死者三十三人, 曾子 quote 出乎尔者反乎尔者也); details and source are correct
